conventions.field_prefix: MMLU-Pro and HellaSwag panels are nested rankings of 500 groups; the first 64 are the A5.8.1 field sample (64 groups per objective); all 500 are reserved as G2 exposure
conventions.fingerprint: '<repo>@<revision>:<split>:<representative item id>' (PREREG §2 dataset-revision/item-ID fingerprint); WikiText uses '<repo>:<config>:<split>@<revision>:<doc_id>'
conventions.hash_convention: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted list of strings), default separators (as text_groups.json)
conventions.item_ids: positional row index in the named split, as TF-v1 item ids; harmful_behaviors uses '<split>:<index>' because its pool spans train and test
conventions.lengths: A5.8.1: WikiText windows are 1,024 tokens; other prompts truncate at 1,024 tokens at G2
conventions.normalize: unicodedata NFKC, str.casefold, whitespace collapsed, stripped
conventions.rank: sha256(domain + fingerprint) ascending as hex; ties by representative id
conventions.text_groups: union-find over the listed keys; a group is excluded if any member is in a scored set; the representative (smallest id) is the panel item and all members are reserved (one item per group, A5.8.1)

wikitext_nll.deviation_from_a5_8_1: A5.8.1 asks for one item per text group; the test split has 60 articles, 12 of them touched by development windows, so 64 one-window-per-article groups do not exist in this split. wikitext_nll.group_rule: text group = article: a ' = Title = ' line with empty neighbouring lines starts an article (sub-headings ' = = ' do not); leading blank lines belong to the first article
